entries.name: MCP hosts (Claude Code, Cursor, Claude Desktop)
entries.what_we_gate: The MCP server that carries the gate, over stdio and Streamable HTTP.
entries.notes: The stdio handshake against the published package proves initialize and tools/list, but no named host was driven. The Claude Desktop, Cursor and Claude Code snippets are documented in README.md only.

entries.name: AI SDK
entries.what_we_gate: Paystage payment tools called from an AI SDK agent loop before the wallet signs.
entries.notes: The tests call the generated tool execute() functions directly; no model loop is driven.

entries.name: elizaOS
entries.what_we_gate: The payment-evaluation action an elizaOS agent runs before signing.
entries.notes: The action handler is driven with a fabricated agent message; no live elizaOS runtime is started.

entries.name: n8n
entries.what_we_gate: The community node that evaluates a proposed x402 payment before a workflow signs it.
entries.notes: The node is driven through a fake n8n execution context and a stubbed HTTP helper; the hosted endpoint it calls is not contacted in the test.

entries.name: @x402/core
entries.what_we_gate: Payment payload creation through paystageClientHook on a real x402 client.
entries.notes: A real @x402/core client is driven with a throwaway key; the allowed case produces a signed payload, and the denied case aborts before anything is signed.

entries.name: @x402/evm
entries.what_we_gate: The EVM scheme's createPaymentPayload call, after the gate returns pay.
entries.notes: ExactEvmScheme from @x402/evm signs only after the hook returns pay. The throwaway key is never funded, so this is not an on-chain payment.

entries.name: x402-fetch (v1, unscoped)
entries.what_we_gate: The buyer's 402 challenge before x402-fetch signs and retries.
entries.notes: The optional peer resolves and the no-peer message is not raised when it is installed. The signed-payment path is delegated to x402-fetch and is stubbed in the test, so this is not a funded end-to-end payment.

entries.name: PayMCP
entries.what_we_gate: The buyer-side evaluation of the x402 challenge PayMCP's Mode.X402 returns to the seller's tool call.
entries.notes: Prose pairing only: the page maps PayMCP's documented 402 challenge to the evaluator input. No PayMCP server was run and no payment was made; their API may move.

entries.notes: Live probe on 2026-11-20: published version 0.8.16 matches the local package. The overall check-listings run exited 1 because other surfaces were stale; this row was current.
